title: Commencement of excavation.
bodyText:
The center shall not prohibit an excavator from beginning excavation work:

(1) After receiving notice that all affected operators have fulfilled the requirements of section 269E-9; or

(2) Five working days after the excavator provides notice of the excavation to the center pursuant to section 269E-7(a); provided that this subsection shall not be construed as affording the excavator any immunity or protection from claims for damages or injuries relating to the excavation.
bodyHtml:
[§269E-10]  Commencement of excavation.  The center shall not prohibit an excavator from beginning excavation work:

     (1)  After receiving notice that all affected operators have fulfilled the requirements of section 269E-9; or

     (2)  Five working days after the excavator provides notice of the excavation to the center pursuant to section 269E-7(a); provided that this subsection shall not be construed as affording the excavator any immunity or protection from claims for damages or injuries relating to the excavation. [L 2004, c 141, pt of §1, §7; am L 2009, c 72, §3]
